# defectdojo_url (Data Source)

Data source for Defect Dojo URL. You can specify either the `id` or the `host` to look up the URL. Note that if multiple URL records share the same host, lookup by `host` will fail; use `id` instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup by host (only works when the host is unique across URL records;
# use id instead when multiple URL records share the same host)
data "defectdojo_url" "example" {
  host = "example.com"
}

# Or lookup by ID
# data "defectdojo_url" "by_id" {
#   id = "1"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) The host of the URL, which can be a domain name or an IP address. Specify either id or host.
- `id` (String) Identifier

### Read-Only

- `fragment` (String) The fragment identifier of the URL (optional)
- `host_validation_failure` (Boolean) Dictates whether the endpoint was found to have host validation issues during creation
- `path` (String) The path of the URL (optional)
- `port` (Number) The port number of the URL (optional)
- `protocol` (String) The protocol of the URL (e.g., http, https, ftp, etc.)
- `query` (String) The query string of the URL (optional)
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the URL
- `type` (String) The type of the URL
- `user_info` (String) Connection details for a given user
